FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Kamau: Salut, Amina ! Ça va ? Amina: Oui, ça va bien, merci. Question: How does Amina answer? (1 mark)
   A. She asks for a present.
   B. She gives her age.
   C. She says she is well.
   D. She says goodbye.

2. What does 'Bonsoir, Madame !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye, Sir.
   B. How do you spell it?
   C. What is your name?
   D. Good evening, Madam!

3. Which little word goes with 'frère' (the brother)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. la

4. What does 'Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. This is my sister.
   C. My mother is called Grace.
   D. My sister is called Njeri.

5. What does 'C'est mon frère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my brother.
   B. Here is my family.
   C. My father is called David.
   D. Here is my grandfather.

6. Which little word goes with 'mère' (the mother)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

7. What does 'Mets le livre sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The ball is behind the door.
   B. The bag is in the bedroom.
   C. Put the book on the table.
   D. It is a table.

8. What does 'Il y a un canapé dans le salon.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The TV is in the living room.
   B. The rug is in front of the sofa.
   C. There is a sofa in the living room.
   D. It is a table.

9. What does 'Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it is Monday.
   B. On Friday, I dance.
   C. On Saturday, I play.
   D. On Saturday, I help my mother.

10. What does 'Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   B. On Sunday, I go to church.
   C. A week, seven days.
   D. What day is it today?

11. What does 'Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My birthday is on 30 June.
   B. When is your birthday?
   C. I am ten years old.
   D. Thank you very much!

12. Which little word goes with 'fête'? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

13. Which little word goes with 'thé' (the tea)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

14. What does 'Ce sont des mangues.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the morning, I eat bread.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. I like milk.
   D. They are mangoes.

15. Read: Voici Amina. Elle a dix ans. Elle est grande. Elle a les cheveux noirs et longs. Elle a deux grands yeux. Question: What colour is Amina's hair? (1 mark)
   A. white
   B. short
   C. brown
   D. black

16. What does 'J'ai deux mains.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has black hair.
   B. She has long hair.
   C. Touch your nose!
   D. I have two hands.

17. What does 'Je reste dans la maison.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. I stay in the house.
   C. There is a storm.
   D. It is snowing.

18. Read: Quand il y a un orage, je reste dans la maison. Je ne vais pas sous un grand arbre. Quand il fait très chaud, je bois de l'eau. Question: Where does the speaker stay in a storm? (1 mark)
   A. at school
   B. in the garden
   C. in the house
   D. under a tree

19. What does 'Tournez à gauche.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is next to the window.
   B. Go straight ahead.
   C. Turn left.
   D. You are welcome!

20. What does 'Le tapis est sous la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rug is under the table.
   B. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   C. Turn right.
   D. Turn left.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: 'Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: 'Il y a un canapé dans le salon.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

23. Explain why accents are important in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Translate into English: 'Bonsoir, Madame !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

25. Translate into English: 'Demain, il fait beau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into English: 'Je mange une mangue.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Translate into English: 'Le frigo est dans la cuisine.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into English: 'Le sac est dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into English: 'Tournez à gauche.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: 'Voici mon grand-père.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Translate into English: 'C'est un lit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — She says she is well.
   Ça va bien, merci means I am well, thank you.

2. D — Good evening, Madam!
   Bonsoir, Madame ! means Good evening, Madam!

3. C — le
   frère is masculine, so we say le frère.

4. D — My sister is called Njeri.
   Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. means My sister is called Njeri.

5. A — This is my brother.
   C'est mon frère. means This is my brother.

6. C — la
   mère is feminine, so we say la mère.

7. C — Put the book on the table.
   Mets le livre sur la table. means Put the book on the table.

8. C — There is a sofa in the living room.
   Il y a un canapé dans le salon. means There is a sofa in the living room.

9. A — Today it is Monday.
   Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi. means Today it is Monday.

10. B — On Sunday, I go to church.
   Le dimanche, je vais à l'église. means On Sunday, I go to church.

11. B — When is your birthday?
   Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ? means When is your birthday?

12. D — la
   fête is feminine, so we say la fête.

13. D — le
   thé is masculine, so we say le thé.

14. D — They are mangoes.
   Ce sont des mangues. means They are mangoes.

15. D — black
   Noirs means black.

16. D — I have two hands.
   J'ai deux mains. means I have two hands.

17. B — I stay in the house.
   Je reste dans la maison. means I stay in the house.

18. C — in the house
   Je reste dans la maison.

19. C — Turn left.
   Tournez à gauche. means Turn left.

20. A — The rug is under the table.
   Le tapis est sous la table. means The rug is under the table.

----

30. (2 marks)
